item.text: I’m applying the same frozen Strategic Advisor runtime to update the recommendation. Your clarification resolves the decisive trade-off: first-submission correctness is the objective, while time savings cannot justify lower quality.

Keep the current process as the production default. Full automation is incompatible with the objective: it lowers correct first submissions from 90% to 65%, a 25-point quality loss.

The only supported automation direction is a bounded hybrid test: automation prepares the submission, staff review it before submission. Adopt it only if comparable cases demonstrate at least 90% correctness while reducing total staff time. Until then, the hybrid is a validation candidate—not an approved replacement.
